sales.title: Sales
sales.overview.description: Every till, every branch and every way customers pay.
sales.overview.emptyTitle: No sales in this period yet
sales.overview.emptyBody: Sales appear here as soon as cashiers close their first shifts in Kassa. Check the tills and payment methods first.
sales.today.title: Right now
sales.today.alert.transit: {n} handovers in transit · {amount} | {n} handover in transit · {amount} | {n} handovers in transit · {amount}
sales.today.emptyBody: Branches you can see appear here with their tills.
sales.kpi.cashShareHint: Share of sales paid in cash
sales.kpi.differenceHint: Counted minus expected, {n} shifts | Counted minus expected, {n} shift | Counted minus expected, {n} shifts
sales.chart.methodsSub: Net sales by how customers paid
sales.chart.branchesSub: Net sales against the previous period
sales.chart.mixSub: Share of each method in every branch
sales.chart.hoursSub: Net sales by weekday and hour
sales.chart.hoursEstimated: Estimated from shift hours: single receipts give exact times
sales.cashiers.title: Cashiers
sales.cashiers.description: Who sells most, whose cash always matches, and who needs a closer look.
sales.cashiers.line: {shifts} shifts · {accuracy} exact | {shifts} shift · {accuracy} exact | {shifts} shifts · {accuracy} exact
sales.cashiers.none: No closed shifts in this period.
sales.cashiers.accuracyHint: Shifts whose cash count was within the tolerance
sales.cashiers.emptyBody: When cashiers close shifts in Kassa, their scorecard appears here.
sales.shifts.title: Shifts
sales.shifts.description: Every cashier shift: totals from the Z-report, the blind cash count and the photos.
sales.shifts.emptyBody: Cashiers open and close shifts in Kassa, the employee app. They show up here at once.
sales.drawer.aiMismatch: The photos don't match the typed totals
sales.drawer.aiMismatchBody: AI read other numbers on the Z-report or the terminal slip. Check them before verifying.
sales.drawer.float: The float differed by {amount} at opening
sales.drawer.floatBody: The last shift left {expected}; the cashier counted {counted}. The difference is booked in the ledger.
sales.drawer.paymentsAtClose: Totals arrive when the cashier closes the shift.
sales.drawer.noPayments: No sales were entered for this shift.
sales.drawer.noMovements: No cash left or entered the till during this shift.
sales.photos.noReading: AI hasn't read these photos. It does when AI is switched on.
sales.count.none: No banknotes were counted one by one.
sales.verify.title: Verify {code}
sales.verify.body: Recount the till if you can. A recount decides the difference.
sales.verify.recountHint: Leave empty when the cashier's count stands.
sales.dispute.title: Dispute {code}?
sales.dispute.body: {name} is told why and the shift waits until it is checked again.
sales.correct.title: Correct {code}
sales.correct.body: Fix the totals per payment method. The ledger follows: what changed is voided and booked again.
sales.correct.countedHint: Only when you recounted the till.
sales.correct.reasonRequired: Say why: it goes into the audit log.
sales.force.title: Force-close {code}?
sales.force.body: {name} left this till open. Close it for them.
sales.force.hint: Totals you don't know now can be added later with a correction.
sales.force.countedHint: Count it now, or leave empty: no difference is booked until someone counts.
sales.movement.title: Record a cash movement
sales.movement.body: Cash leaving or entering a till. A handover moves only when its receiver confirms.
sales.movement.receiverHint: They confirm in Telegram, in Kassa or here.
sales.movement.reasonRequired: Say what the money was paid for.
sales.cash.title: Cash
sales.cash.description: Where every so‘m is right now: tills, safes, in transit, with people and in the bank.
sales.cash.transitHint: {n} handovers waiting | {n} handover waiting | {n} handovers waiting
sales.cash.peopleHint: {n} people hold cash | {n} person holds cash | {n} people hold cash
sales.cash.declineBody: {name} says they handed you {amount}. The owners are told at once.
sales.cash.declinedHint: Find out what happened, then void the handover if the cash is still in the till.
sales.cash.openHint: Open tills show their float and movements so far: their sales are added when the shift closes.
sales.cash.noPeopleBody: Confirmed handovers land on the receiver's own cash account.
sales.cash.noMovementsBody: Payouts, handovers and safe drops from Kassa and from here appear in this list.
sales.cash.voidBody: {kind} of {amount}. Its ledger rows are voided and the shift's expected cash follows.
sales.targets.title: Targets
sales.targets.description: Monthly goals for the company, each branch and each cashier, with daily pacing.
sales.targets.chartSub: Net sales added up day by day, against an even path to the target
sales.targets.emptyBody: Set a goal and see each day whether the company, a branch or a cashier is on pace.
sales.targets.removeBody: The month's sales stay; only the goal goes.
sales.entries.title: Receipts
sales.entries.description: Single receipts: recorded in Kassa during shifts, or entered here for orders made away from the till.
sales.entries.newBody: It books into the ledger on its own, on the branch you pick.
sales.entries.needMethod: Choose how each amount was paid.
sales.entries.shiftMode: Tills record totals from the Z-report at close. Receipts here are for sales made away from the till.
sales.entries.emptyBody: Switch Kassa to single receipts in the sales rules, or enter a receipt here.
sales.setup.title: Tills & payment methods
sales.setup.description: The tills each branch runs, how customers pay, and the rules Kassa follows.
sales.registers.newBody: It gets its own cash account in the ledger.
sales.registers.name: Name
sales.registers.archiveBody: Cashiers can't open shifts on it any more. Its history stays.
sales.registers.emptyBody: Add a till for each cash desk your branches run.
sales.registers.footnote: Differences up to {tolerance} count as exact. Change it in Rules.
sales.methods.hint: In the order cashiers see them in Kassa.
sales.methods.name: Name
sales.methods.accountHint: The account this money reaches, e.g. the card terminal.
sales.methods.feeHint: Booked as a bank fee when a shift closes.
sales.settings.recordingHint: Kassa follows this in the employee app.
sales.settings.mode.shift_totalsHint: Cashiers type the Z-report totals at close.
sales.settings.mode.receiptsHint: Each sale with its payment method, for branches without a cash register.
sales.settings.dayEndsHint: Sales before this time count for the day before.
sales.settings.toleranceHint: Differences up to this count as exact.
sales.settings.controlHint: What a cashier has to do to close a shift.
sales.settings.blindHint: Cashiers count without seeing how much there should be, until a manager verifies.
sales.settings.terminalPhotoHint: Required when the shift took cards or wallets.
sales.settings.alertsHint: Managers and owners hear in the dashboard and in Telegram.
sales.settings.lateOpenHint: After the opening time, no till open.
sales.settings.bigPayoutHint: Payouts from a till at or above this.
sales.widget.soFar: From the shifts closed so far
sales.flow.soFar: Float minus cash out, before sales
sales.import.title: Import sale lines
sales.import.description: Sale lines from your cash-register program, for true stock, margins and the legal price check. The tills' totals stay your sales figures.
sales.import.offBody: Choose “Imported from the cash-register program” in Settings → Sales, then add a profile for your program.
sales.import.uploadHint: The export of your cash-register program, CSV or Excel. A receipt already imported is left out, so a file uploaded twice adds nothing.
sales.import.noProfileBody: A profile says how to read your program's file: which column holds the receipt, the item code, the quantity and the price.
sales.import.drop: Choose the export or drop it here
sales.import.uploaded: Uploaded. The file is being read.
sales.import.emptyBody: Upload the day's export of your cash-register program to see what was sold, line by line.
sales.import.profilesHint: One profile per cash-register program. Its column map is saved once and used for every file.
sales.import.reading: The file is being read. This page updates by itself.
sales.import.unmatchedTitle: {n} line waits for a match | {n} lines wait for a match
sales.import.unmatchedBody: The catalogue doesn't know these item codes yet. Match each code once: its lines take their stock then, and the code is remembered.
sales.import.breachesTitle: {n} prescription line above the legal price | {n} prescription lines above the legal price
sales.import.breachesBody: A prescription medicine may not cost more than its batch cost plus the legal markup, nor more than its reference price. The tax app compares receipt prices with them.
sales.import.dayCheckHint: What the files brought per pharmacy and day against the tills' totals. A gap above 1 % is marked.
sales.import.noDays: No receipts came in with this file.
sales.import.flaggedHint: {n} day doesn't match the tills: check that the file is complete and every shift is closed. | {n} days don't match the tills: check that the files are complete and every shift is closed.
sales.import.problems: {n} thing to check | {n} things to check
sales.match.hint: Match a code once: it is remembered for every next file.
sales.match.emptyBody: Each line of the imported files found its medicine in the catalogue.
sales.match.skipBody: “{name}” stops waiting: it isn't goods the stock keeps (a bag, a service). You can still match it later.
sales.match.dialogBody: “{name}” is on {n} line. Pick the medicine it is: the line takes its stock, and the code is remembered. | “{name}” is on {n} lines. Pick the medicine it is: the lines take their stock, and the code is remembered.
sales.lines.title: Sale lines
sales.lines.description: What was sold, item by item, from your cash-register program, with each prescription medicine checked against its legal price.
sales.lines.offHint: Sale lines come from imports. Turn them on in Settings → Sales.
sales.lines.oneImport: Showing the lines of one file.
sales.lines.capHint: The most a prescription medicine may cost a pack: the batch cost plus the legal markup, never above the reference price.
sales.lines.emptyBody: Lines appear here once a file of your cash-register program is imported.
sales.lines.noCost: The cost arrives with the stock module's batches.
sales.pos.description: The names or codes your cash-register program puts on receipts. Link each to a person once: their imported receipts follow, earlier ones too.
sales.pos.emptyBody: They appear with the first imported file that names its cashiers.
sales.profile.description: How to read one cash-register program's export. Saved once, used for every file.
sales.profile.name: Name
sales.profile.branchHint: The pharmacy whose till made the file, or a column of the file naming it.
sales.profile.defaultUnitHint: When the file has no unit column.
sales.profile.headerRowHint: 1 unless the file starts with a title.
sales.profile.dateFormatHint: Empty: the usual formats are recognized.
sales.profile.activeHint: An archived profile takes no new files.
sales.profile.mapperHint: Choose a sample export: the columns it recognizes are mapped for you, and its first 20 rows show what will be read.
sales.profile.field.name: Item name
sales.settings.lines.title: Sale lines
sales.settings.lines.hint: Where the sale lines (what was sold, item by item) come from. With them stock, margins and the legal price check are exact; the tills' totals stay the sales figures.
sales.settings.lines.noneHint: Stock moves through receipts of goods, transfers, write-offs and counts.
sales.settings.lines.importHint: Upload its export every day; the Import page and the match list appear.
sales.settings.lines.receiptsHint: For a pharmacy without software of its own. Arrives in a later version.
